comms: [OVERWATCH] Operative, Kharon Outpost has been silent for nine days. Get inside and find out why.
[OVERWATCH] Facility security AI is designated WARDEN. It is not answering our hails.

objectives.text: Restore power in the Generator Hall ({gen_dir} wing)
comms: [OVERWATCH] Main power is down and the bulkheads are mag-locked. The generator hall is {gen_dir} of the atrium.
[OVERWATCH] Power is up. Bulkheads are opening. Get into the research wing and pull their archives.

objectives.text: Discover the cause of the incident (Xenolab, {xeno_dir})
comms: [OVERWATCH] Project ECHO... we have no record of that. Get to the Xenolab and find Dr. Varrow's data.

objectives.text: Destroy WARDEN in the Security Core ({core_dir})
comms: [OVERWATCH] ...God's teeth. All right, Operative. WARDEN is the threat. Take it offline.
[OVERWATCH] Be advised: expect heavy resistance in the Security Core.

objectives.text: Reach the Containment Vault and extract
comms: [OVERWATCH] WARDEN signature is gone. Vault bulkhead is open to the {vault_dir} of the core. Secure the recording and extract.
